Louisville, KY… what a weekend! 🍂💃  

Had an absolute blast with my girl tribe, the kind of trip that fills your heart and soul all at once. We laughed until we couldn’t breathe, had those deep, soul-soothing conversations that only happen with your closest friends, and danced through the night a little tipsy and totally free.  

Days were spent exploring the city, taking in all the sights, and strolling through long, picturesque autumn paths that looked straight out of a painting. Our stay in a gorgeous Victorian mansion made it all feel like a dream, with cozy mornings, endless giggles, and memories that will live forever.  

There’s something magical about being surrounded by women who lift you up, love you as you are, and remind you how good it feels to be free, to be *me*, and to truly enjoy life. 🥂✨
